test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: _________ is one of the highest motorable roads in the world, and is a mountain pass in the Himalayan peaks that co joins Sikkim and China's Tibet Autonomous Region.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nathu La**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Nathu La pass is in Sikkim, India.
 
• It connects the Indian state of Sikkim with China's Tibet autonomous region.
 
• The pass is 4310 meters above sea level.
